tasks.title: Engine plan 0001 after the pre-flight audit: T17, T18 and T19 can be written and pass the gate
tasks.prTitle: docs(eng-harness): engine plan T17 to T19 after the pre-flight audit (block-module imports, sink seam, tests-first) (B-509)
tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. Documents-only amendment of packages/eng-harness/docs/plans/0001-engine.md (and spec 0001 only where a finding needs one sentence), priority work item on the first-live-run path: engine tasks T17, T18 and T19 are written next, right after T16 and T16b. SOURCE: the owner approved a pre-flight audit of the plans (playbook section 7 item 1); its confirmed findings for this plan are in <lead>/reports/plan-audit/engine-0001-confirmed.md (lead material, never cited by path in the repository; read it fully: five confirmed findings F1 to F5, each with the auditor's evidence and a verifier's verdict and corrected edit; the list of rejected findings at its end is NOT to be applied). For each confirmed finding: re-check the evidence yourself against origin/build/v1 as it is now (other amendments merged since: read `git log origin/build/v1 -15`), then make the smallest plan edit that removes the stop (D-28), preferring the verifier's corrected edit where it gives one. Guidance per finding: F1 (T17, the block-module allowlist of spec 0001 section 4.1.2 against the merged workflow modules that import eng_harness.kinds.edit_cycle and eng_contract.units): LEAD DECISION: follow the precedent of amendments B-493 (pull request 340) and B-462 (pull request 336), which admitted kinds modules to calc modules by exact name after checking what the admitted module itself imports; do the same check here (if an admitted module pulls in anything impure or host-facing, say so and do not admit it: report the alternative), write the admission into section 4.1.2 in the form those amendments used, keep AC19 as it is, and replace the stale T17 prose 'empty until later specs add blocks'. F2, F4, F5 (tests_first entries that cannot be red at the base, gate rule TF004): read tools/eng-dev-gate/src/eng_dev_gate/checks/test_first.py and test_first_run.py and the gate spec section on test-first to see exactly which tests of which commit are judged and which pull request types are exempt, and how amendment B-482 (plan 0004 T10) and the audit's corrected edits solved the same cause; then fix each task's tests_first and prose so that a writer following the plan passes the gate: for a task that adds no source (T19, the crash matrix) state the pull request type and commit layout the gate accepts for a test-only change, and if no layout passes the gate as it is, do NOT invent one: report the exact gate rule as a lead finding and leave T19 marked blocked on it. F3 (T18, the progress sink has no seam inside T18's files for AC58): give the seam a home with the smallest file addition the merged code supports (name the file and what changes in it), re-estimate T18's budget from merged tasks of the same kind, split only if it passes 380. Rules: every acceptance criterion stays covered (GC016), tests_first files belong to their task (TF008), each task at most 400 lines, depends_on ids exist; do not touch T16, T16b (being written now) or the task that amendment B-503 adds at the end of the plan (merge origin/build/v1 into your branch before you finish and keep both). Where a finding needs a decision the documents do not contain, add a numbered open question to spec 0001 with a recommendation marked as the writer's and list it in your summary. Do not edit code or lead state files. Run `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation`. In your summary give the lead, per finding: applied as, or not applied and why; every changed task with files, tests_first, budget; and the pull request title type each of T17, T18, T19 must carry. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.

Check that what T10 provides is what providers plan 0009 T10a expects (the audit found no confirmed mismatch: say so in one line or report one). Run `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation`.
